findings.note: Term drift inside the namespace: the new key says «беседе/беседу» for 'conversation' while sibling keys default_saved says «для этого разговора» / «разговоров». Core (relay.chrome, wire.bridge_taint) uses «беседа», the desktop UI catalogue uses «разговор». Not wrong Russian, and changing it would break the byte-identity with core wire.bridge_taint.card_options_off; recorded, not blocking. Remedy if wanted: change core and UI together to one term.

Mode name 'auto' (first occurrence, «Allow all» и auto отключены) stays lowercase Latin while the same card's siblings render the mode as «Авто» (mode.auto, set_session, set_all, default_saved). The second 'auto' is the argument of the typed command /approvals auto and must stay Latin, which is correct. 'Allow all' is a TUI card label and is kept Latin in «ёлочки» per core; defensible. Recorded, not blocking.
